verdict.rationale: Bento is an observability and improvement platform for AI agents. It has its own AI-driven features, such as signals trained on traces and incident judging, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it accepts MCP servers as tool sources. However, the evidence never documents Bento acting as an MCP client or letting users register external MCP servers. The only MCP mention is coding agents loading Bento's docs over MCP, which is Bento serving content to other agents, not consuming tools.
